audience: freelancers, agencies and project teams who track time and invoice clients in Harvest

useCases.title: Summarize hours logged by project, client or person
useCases.text: The AI lists time entries filtered by user, project, client, task or date range and adds them up, so you see who logged how many hours and where.

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoices for a client
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices filtered by client, project, state or date range and opens one to show its line items, so you know what is still open.

useCases.title: List expenses that are not yet billed
useCases.text: The AI lists expenses filtered by billed status, client, project or date range and totals them, so you can see what is ready to bill.

useCases.title: Log hours or start, stop and restart a timer
useCases.text: The AI finds your project and task assignments, then creates a time entry with hours or a start time, or starts a running timer. You can stop or restart it later.

useCases.title: Fix or delete a wrong time entry
useCases.text: The AI finds a time entry and changes its hours, notes, date, project or task. It can also delete the entry for good when you ask.
